title: Container-Responsive Card
prompt: Make `.slot` a size container, then inside `@container (min-width: 420px)` give `.card` a two-column grid (`120px 1fr`). Below that width the card stays a single column — all without media queries.
boilerplate:
img
text

tests.name: slot is a size container
tests.code:
const css = code;
if (!/\.slot\s*{[^}]*container-type\s*:\s*inline-size/i.test(css)) throw new Error("Mark .slot with container-type: inline-size.");

tests.name: card switches to two columns inside the container query
